title: Frog Laughing
blurb: Wheezy, squeaky, and sounding uncannily like your weirdest friend losing composure at two in the morning. The laughing frog became a beloved reaction sound because it is reliably funnier than whatever it is responding to, which is a genuinely rare property. Use it when something is stupid-funny rather than clever-funny — the frog is a specialist in the former and has no interest at all in wit. It is close to impossible to hear this without smiling, which is more than can be said for most laughs.
origin: A viral clip of a frog making a laugh-like squeak.
